subject: Mutual action plan — POC environment connectivity & SSO/KMS checkpoints
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Nelson <a.nelson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual action plan — POC environment connectivity & SSO/KMS checkpoints

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion I wanted to capture the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items specific to the POC environment so we have clear milestones, owners, and the minimal dependencies to get your test cluster up and running. Attached is a one-page MAP draft and a simple network diagram for reference.

High-level milestones (target timeline in parentheses):
- Network peering established (target: 2026-12-22) — owner: Acme DevOps (coordinate maintenance window)
- IP allowlist + egress rules applied (target: 2026-12-22) — owner: Acme DevOps (Redwood to provide egress list)
- SSO / SAML integration validated (target: 2026-12-29) — owner: Acme Identity team (Redwood to provide SAML metadata)
- Secrets / KMS key access confirmed (target: 2027-01-05) — owner: Acme Security (Redwood to confirm key exchange pattern)
- POC environment smoke tests & signoff (target: 2027-01-10) — owner: joint (Acme + Redwood)

Immediate asks for your team to confirm:
1) SSO admin contact (name / email) to receive SAML metadata.
2) Window(s) available for peering work (2–4 hour block between 12/20–12/23).
3) Whether Acme will provide a customer-managed KMS key (BYOK) or if you prefer Redwood-managed key material for the POC.

Ben and Karthik are copied for technical follow-ups. I suggest we hold a 30-minute runbook walkthrough once peering + allowlist are in place — propose 2026-12-23 or 12-29. Please confirm availability and any additional compliance artifacts you need ahead of procurement (e.g., SOC2 evidence).

Thanks — I’ll iterate the MAP file after receiving your inputs.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), network-diagram.pdf (POC VPC sketch)
From: Aisha Nelson <a.nelson@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-12-13T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — POC environment connectivity & SSO/KMS checkpoints

Monica — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side before we lock milestones: 

- SSO contact: sso-admin@acmehealth.com (Samir Patel, Identity Admin). Please send SAML metadata to that address.
- Peering windows: we can do maintenance windows nightly 22:00–02:00 UTC. The team prefers minimal changes during holiday weeks; 12/22 is OK but 12/23 may be tight. Can Redwood support the 22:00–02:00 UTC window?
- IP allowlist: we need a compact list of egress IPs (single CIDR ranges if possible). Our security team will escalate any long lists.
- KMS: for the POC we prefer Redwood-managed keys (faster), but for production we’ll require BYOK. Please confirm if Redwood supports both and the required IAM roles/service accounts.

Also, procurement will likely request SOC2 Type II evidence and a short data handling one-pager. Can you surface those docs?

I’ll loop in our procurement contact once we have dates.

—Aisha
Aisha Nelson
Senior DevOps Engineer | Acme Health
a.nelson@acmehealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Nelson <a.nelson@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T12:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — POC environment connectivity & SSO/KMS checkpoints

Thanks Aisha — quick technical answers and what we’ll attach: 

1) Peering window — we can support the 22:00–02:00 UTC slot on 2026-12-22. For safety we recommend a 2-hour planned window (we’ll only need one direction to finish routing and security rules).

2) Egress IPs — for the POC we can provide aggregated CIDRs to simplify allowlisting. Attached is redwood-egress-ips.csv which contains our recommended ranges (short list). If you have a strict single-CIDR requirement we can consolidate to a /20 as a fallback, but that increases surface area.

3) SSO/SAML — Redwood will produce SAML metadata (EntityID / ACS URL / cert) and we’ll send to sso-admin@acmehealth.com. We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Test user creation can be done with a temporary test user we create, or you can provide a sandbox account.

4) KMS/Secrets — Redwood supports both Redwood-managed keys for quick POC and BYOK for production. For BYOK we require an IAM role with the following permissions: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:DescribeKey. We’ll document the minimal role and a sample CloudFormation snippet in the runbook attachment.

Attachments referenced: network-diagram.pdf (updated), redwood-egress-ips.csv, runbook-network-peering.md (attachment stub).

If that looks good, Monica and I will update the MAP with the confirmed dates and owners.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Nelson <a.nelson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — POC environment connectivity & SSO/KMS checkpoints

Great — thank you both. Action items I’ll record in the MAP and assign: 
- Acme: confirm maintenance window 2026-12-22 22:00–00:00 UTC (or extend to 02:00 if needed) — owner: Aisha Nelson (sso-admin@acmehealth.com)
- Acme: apply allowlist using attached redwood-egress-ips.csv — owner: DevOps team
- Redwood: send SAML metadata to sso-admin@acmehealth.com by EOD 2026-12-14 — owner: Karthik
- Redwood: provide runbook and minimal IAM snippet for BYOK flows — owner: Ben (attached)
- Both: schedule 30-minute runbook walkthrough (options: 2026-12-23 17:00 PST / 2026-12-29 09:00 PST) — owner: Monica to schedule once SSO contact confirmed

Target POC live date: 2027-01-10 — I’ll mark this as tentative and update once peering + SSO are validated. I’ll attach the updated MAP and send a calendar invite for the walkthrough once you confirm the SSO admin address.

If procurement needs SOC2 artifacts, I can drop the standard security pack into your procurement contact’s shared folder — ping me the procurement email and I’ll share.

Thanks — looking forward to the quick win here.

Best,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
